ComputedTestResultRequest.description:
A test outcome computed outside this service (e.g. conveyor QA).

``tenant_id`` and ``project_id`` are intentionally absent: the tenant comes from
the authenticated caller and the project from the ``X-Project-Id`` header (sent
by the n8n node and the gateway on every call), never from the body.

Two input forms:

* explicit: ``success`` / ``execution_time_ms`` / ``stdout`` / ``stderr`` /
  ``resource_usage`` sent by the caller;
* ``junit_summary``: the raw parsed report; the service DERIVES those five fields
  (success = tests > 0 and failures + errors == 0 and passed > 0 and exit_code == 0 —
  a run that executed nothing, or whose runner exited non-zero, is never a pass). Mixing the two is a 422 — the
  generated n8n node omits false / 0 / "" values, so an explicit value next to a
  summary is ambiguous and must fail loudly.

``test_id`` may be omitted only with a ``junit_summary`` and a ``card_id``: it is then
derived by the route (:func:`derive_computed_test_id`) as
``{source}:{card_id}:{sha256(tenant_id, container_name, commit_sha, exit_code, junit_summary)[:32]}``,
so an identical re-run in the same scope collapses to one row and a different outcome gets its own.

junit_summary.description: Raw parsed junit report; when present the service derives success, timing, stdout, stderr, resource_usage

test_id.description: Idempotency key, e.g. aaqa:{card}:{corr}; derived when omitted (needs junit_summary + card_id)
test_id.title: Test Id

info.description:
Multi-language test execution and AI-powered test analysis service.

## Auth
Istio-forwarded headers (`x-user-id`, `x-tenant-id`, `x-user-roles`), optional trusted-network bypass for source IPs listed in `TRUSTED_CIDRS` (default: empty — no source IP is trusted), API key fallback (`Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`) in dev/test.

## Endpoint Groups
- **Testing & Quality** (`/api/tests`): execute, batch, quality-check, quality-scan, language/tool discovery, containers, health, metrics
- **Test Execution** (`/api/tests/execute`): containerized execution, batch, active executions, cleanup, container specs
- **Test Orchestration** (`/api/tests/orchestration`): suites, plans, execution history, orchestration metrics
- **Intelligent Testing** (`/api/tests/ai`): AI-powered analysis, pattern detection, failure prediction, smart test selection, impact analysis, recommendations
- **Test Results Data** (`/api/tests`): raw result retrieval, history, store externally-analyzed results
- **Health** (`/api/health`): readiness, liveness, detailed, system metrics

post.description:
**Perform security validation on code before execution.**

    Analyzes code for potentially dangerous patterns and security risks:

    **Detection Capabilities**:
    - File system operations (read/write/delete)
    - Network access and HTTP requests
    - Process execution and shell commands
    - Code evaluation (eval, exec)
    - Import of dangerous modules
    - SQL injection patterns
    - Path traversal attempts

    **Risk Scoring**:
    - 0-25: Low risk - safe for execution
    - 26-50: Medium risk - review recommended
    - 51-75: High risk - manual approval needed
    - 76-100: Critical risk - execution blocked
